occurrences.text: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
